day4_night_start.name: {name}
day4_night_start.text: *I get home. A little park dirt and school dust cling to my sleeves.*

day4_teacher_seoyeon_counteroffer.name: Seoyeon
day4_teacher_seoyeon_counteroffer.text: *As I leave school after parting with my homeroom teacher, Seoyeon is waiting by the rooftop stairs. She's smiling, but her grip tightens around her uniform sleeve.* You've only had eyes for the teacher lately. Just tonight, can't you look at me—not the student council president or the model student, just me?
choices: Keep my promise to my homeroom teacher and leave
Follow Seoyeon to the rooftop and take her hand

day4_teacher_dain_counteroffer.name: Dain
day4_teacher_dain_counteroffer.text: *After promising my homeroom teacher I'd message when I arrived, I pass the gym. Dain leans against the dark emergency door, picking at the tape on her knee.* You only go to the teacher these days. Return ten serves for me. When we're done... hold me tonight.
choices: Message my homeroom teacher that I'm coming back
Enter the gym and accept Dain's request

day4_teacher_yuna_counteroffer.name: Yuna
day4_teacher_yuna_counteroffer.text: *Right after I part with my homeroom teacher, Yuna sends a photo of the annex. Two empty chairs sit side by side, her jacket draped over one.* I guess you're more comfortable beside the teacher. But if you leave tonight, I think I'll feel abandoned all over again.
choices: Reply to my homeroom teacher and go home
Go to the annex and stay with Yuna

day4_nurse_seoyeon_counteroffer.name: Seoyeon
day4_nurse_seoyeon_counteroffer.text: *On my way from the nurse's office to the front gate, Seoyeon blocks the rooftop stairs. Her lips force a smile while her fingers crumple her uniform sleeve.* You only visit the school nurse lately. Just tonight, can't you look at me—not the student council president or the model student, just me?
choices: Reply to the school nurse and leave
Follow Seoyeon to the rooftop and take her hand

day4_nurse_dain_counteroffer.name: Dain
day4_nurse_dain_counteroffer.text: *When I close the nurse's office door behind me, Dain is standing by the gym's emergency exit. She peels the tape from her knee and presses it back down without meeting my eyes.* You only go to the school nurse these days. Return ten serves for me. When we're done... hold me tonight.
choices: Message the school nurse that I'm coming back
Enter the gym and accept Dain's request

day4_nurse_yuna_counteroffer.name: Yuna
day4_nurse_yuna_counteroffer.text: *After I leave the nurse's office, Yuna sends a photo of the annex. Her jacket rests on one of two empty chairs.* I guess you're more comfortable beside the nurse. But if you leave tonight, I think I'll feel abandoned all over again.
choices: Reply to the school nurse and go home
Go to the annex and stay with Yuna

day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_seoyeon.name: {name}
day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_seoyeon.text: *As the rooftop door closes, Seoyeon catches {name}'s wrist and places their hand over her chest. Her loosened ribbon leaves her shirt collar open, and her trembling breath brushes the back of their hand. The phone in their pocket buzzes again and again, but Seoyeon doesn't let go. Much later, they leave the school and return home.*

day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_dain.name: {name}
day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_dain.text: *The last ball rolls across the floor. Catching her ragged breath, Dain grips the front of her uniform and pulls it down. She leans in until her sweat-warmed breath reaches {name}'s face. The phone in their pocket keeps buzzing. Much later, they leave the school and return home.*

day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_yuna.name: {name}
day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_yuna.text: *Yuna steps right up to {name}, bracing one hand on the bookcase. She lets her jacket slip below one shoulder and uses her other hand to tug down the neckline beneath it. Between her bare shoulder and tattoo, her red eyes stay level with {name}. The phone on the desk buzzes again. Much later, they leave the annex and return home.*

day4_adult_night_regret_teacher.name: {name}
day4_adult_night_regret_teacher.text: *Back home, I turn on my phone and see my homeroom teacher's message: 'I asked you to let me know when you arrived. Is something wrong?' My hand stops over the reply box.*

day4_adult_night_regret_nurse.name: {name}
day4_adult_night_regret_nurse.text: *Back home, I turn on my phone and see the school nurse's message: 'You looked a little unwell earlier. Did you get home safely?' My hand stops over the reply box before I can type that I'm fine.*

wall_seo_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_1.text: *10 PM. A call from Seoyeon. There's no laughter in her voice.*

wall_seo_pre_high_1.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pre_high_1.text: Can I be honest with you tonight?

wall_seo_pre_high_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_high_2.text: *Seoyeon's breathing is the first thing I hear through the phone.*

wall_seo_pre_low_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_low_1.text: *There have been no new notifications in Seoyeon's chat since her last message.*

wall_seo_pre_low_1b.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_low_1b.text: *I text, “Seoyeon, are you okay right now?” A read receipt appears one minute later, but no reply follows. Then my phone rings.*

wall_seo_pre_low_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pre_low_2.text: I saw your text. Can we talk for a minute?

wall_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_2.text: Can you come out now? The park. Sorry it's so sudden.

wall_seo_to_park.name: {name}
wall_seo_to_park.text: *I leave the house and head to the park.*

wall_seo_3.name: {name}
wall_seo_3.text: *Seoyeon sits on a park bench. The edges of her makeup are slightly smudged.*

wall_seo_6.name: {name}
wall_seo_6.text: *I sit beside her. Seoyeon stares at the ground in front of the bench through lenses streaked with streetlight.*

wall_seo_7_b.name: {name}
wall_seo_7_b.text: *A car passes along the park road. Seoyeon interlaces her fingers in her lap.*

wall_seo_9_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_9_b.text: My family looks fine on the outside, right? Big house, nice car, student council president's daughter.

wall_seo_9_c.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_9_c.text: But Mom and Dad have been strangers living under the same roof for a year. They just haven't signed the papers yet.

wall_seo_9_d.name: {name}
wall_seo_9_d.text: *A dry leaf rolls beneath the bench and stops in front of Seoyeon's sneaker.*

wall_seo_10.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_10.text: So I smiled at home and at school. It was the easiest thing to do.

wall_seo_11.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_11.text: Mom said, 'If you fall apart, this house falls apart too.'

wall_seo_11_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_11_b.text: *She presses her lips shut. As if swallowing.*

wall_seo_12.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_12.text: I was ten. — She said that to a ten-year-old.

wall_seo_13.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_13.text: Since then, I practiced getting my expression right in front of the mirror. If it looked wrong, I started over.

wall_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_14.text: Whenever someone praised me, the first thing I counted was how many tries it had taken in the mirror.

wall_seo_14_c.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_14_c.text: *Her words cut off as her fingers dig into one another in her lap. A drop at the edge of her glasses falls onto the back of her hand.*

wall_seo_14_d.name: {name}
wall_seo_14_d.text: *Tears run down without a sound. Makeup smears across the back of her hand as Seoyeon looks at {name} through her glasses.*

wall_seo_hug_choice.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_choice.text: *Smeared makeup remains on the back of her hand, and Seoyeon's shoulders lift in short motions with every breath.*
choices: Hold her
Hold out a hand

wall_seo_hug_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_hug_1.text: *I hold Seoyeon. She buries her face in my shoulder, soaking my uniform shirt.*

wall_seo_hug_2_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_2_b.text: It's been a long time since I cried in front of anyone.

wall_seo_hug_2_c.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_2_c.text: Eight years. All that time, I only ever cried alone in the bathroom.

wall_seo_hug_3.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_3.text: *Her breath hits my shoulder in short bursts.*

wall_seo_pinky_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_pinky_2.text: Call me at night too. I won't ask questions.

wall_seo_pinky_4.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pinky_4.text: Don't say things like that so easily.

wall_seo_pinky_5_b.name: {name}
wall_seo_pinky_5_b.text: *Seoyeon's hand touches my palm. It's cold.*

wall_seo_line_choice.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_line_choice.text: *She wipes her eyes with the back of her hand, spreading the makeup stain wider.*
choices: Want a wet wipe?
Let's sit here for a minute.
I think I get it. You don't have to explain.

wall_seo_line_react_1.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_line_react_1.text: *She looks down at the makeup stain on the back of her hand.*

wall_seo_after_line.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line.text: Wait. Do you have a wet wipe?

wall_seo_after_line_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_2.text: *Seoyeon looks down at the back of her hand. Her makeup is smeared.*

wall_seo_after_line_4.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_4.text: *She takes the wet wipe I pull from my pocket.*

wall_seo_after_line_5.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_5.text: That's better. I'll have to remember to bring some tomorrow.

wall_seo_skin70_1.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_skin70_1.text: *After making sure she has permission, Seoyeon takes my hand. Our joined hands rest between us on the bench.*

wall_seo_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_skin60_1.text: *We sit side by side on the bench. Leaving a shoulder's width between us, Seoyeon looks toward {name}.*

wall_seo_skin60_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_skin60_2.text: Let's stay like this a little longer.

wall_seo_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_1.text: *After walking Seoyeon home, I follow the school wall back. Dain stands by the dark gym's emergency door, picking at the tape around her knee.*

wall_seo_glimpse_2.name: Dain
wall_seo_glimpse_2.text: Just return ten. When we're done... hug me, okay? I can't keep pretending I'm fine by myself tonight.
choices: Keep my promise to Seoyeon and go home
Enter the gym and stay with Dain

wall_seo_glimpse_4.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_4.text: *The last ball rolls across the floor. Dain catches her breath, grips the front hem of her jersey, and pulls it taut. She bends low until her breath, still hot from training, is only inches from {name}. Seoyeon's messages keep the phone buzzing in the pocket.*

wall_seo_yuna_tempt_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_yuna_tempt_1.text: *On the way home, Yuna texts, 'The annex light is still on.' A photo follows: two empty chairs side by side.*

wall_seo_yuna_tempt_2.name: Yuna
wall_seo_yuna_tempt_2.text: Someone who once noticed me disappeared without a word. If you leave tonight, it feels like that day will happen all over again. Just for tonight, stay here.
choices: Reply to Seoyeon and keep my promise
Go to the annex and stay beside Yuna

wall_seo_yuna_tempt_accept.name: {name}
wall_seo_yuna_tempt_accept.text: *Yuna steps right up to {name} and braces one hand against the shelf. She lets her blazer slip below one shoulder and uses the other hand to tug down the neckline of her dark top. Between her bare shoulder and tattoo, her red eyes stay level with {name}. Seoyeon's message—'Did you make it home too?'—stays at the top of the screen.*

wall_dain_pre_high_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_pre_high_1.text: Can we talk about something other than sports today?

wall_dain_pre_low_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_pre_low_1.text: *She smiles. Her hand is pressing hard on the knee brace.*

wall_dain_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_2.text: Hey, do you have time right now?

wall_dain_2_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_2_b.text: *We're not supposed to be at school, right?*

wall_dain_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_3.text: Just come. I left the gym's back door open.

wall_dain_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_4.text: *Only the emergency lights are on in the gym. Dain bounces a volleyball by herself. The corners of her mouth are raised, but her shoulders are rigid near her ears.*

wall_dain_6.name: {name}
wall_dain_6.text: Why are you at school at night?

wall_dain_7.name: Dain
wall_dain_7.text: I sneak in sometimes. To practice.

wall_dain_8.name: Dain
wall_dain_8.text: Set one for me. Just once.

wall_dain_8_b.name: {name}
wall_dain_8_b.text: *While I hesitate with the ball in my hands, Dain takes a step forward. Her right knee gives out, and she drops into a crouch.*

wall_dain_9.name: {name}
wall_dain_9.text: *The ball rolls across the gym floor.*

wall_dain_10.name: Dain
wall_dain_10.text: No, I'm fine! I just twisted it a little, it's noth—

wall_dain_11.name: {name}
wall_dain_11.text: *Her hand gripping her knee has gone white. — It's not nothing.*

wall_dain_12_c.name: {name}
wall_dain_12_c.text: *The ball rolling across the floor hits the wall with a low thud.*

wall_dain_13.name: {name}
wall_dain_13.text: *I sit beside her without a word. Dain closes her mouth. The gym lights hum softly.*

wall_dain_14_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_14_b.text: *She does not look at the volleyball.*

wall_dain_16.name: Dain
wall_dain_16.text: *The corners of her mouth fall. Her eyes stay on a white line across the court.*

wall_dain_16_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_16_b.text: I had surgery, and the doctors — they were really careful with their words.

wall_dain_17.name: Dain
wall_dain_17.text: After surgery, the doctor drew a line on paper. 'Daily life' ends here, 'athlete' starts here. I don't remember much after that.

wall_dain_18.name: Dain
wall_dain_18.text: My mom was crying when we left the hospital. — I couldn't cry. It just hadn't sunk in yet.

wall_dain_18_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_18_b.text: It finally sank in — when I was cleaning out the gym lockers.

wall_dain_18_c.name: {name}
wall_dain_18_c.text: *The gym's emergency light flickers once. Dain's nail traces a groove in the ball.*

wall_dain_18_d.name: Dain
wall_dain_18_d.text: *Her thumb rubs a groove in the ball.* So.

wall_dain_19.name: Dain
wall_dain_19.text: I didn't tell anyone. Not even my parents. 'Dain wouldn't be Dain if she couldn't play!' — I didn't want to hear that.

wall_dain_19_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_19_b.text: *She clutches the front of her uniform.*

wall_dain_20.name: Dain
wall_dain_20.text: Every time someone at school said, “You've got so much energy!” my chest tightened first.

wall_dain_20_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_20_b.text: Even when I breathed, it never went all the way in.

wall_dain_21.name: Dain
wall_dain_21.text: Today too. Running around on our date. Pretending to be cheerful beside you. My knee kept giving out.

wall_dain_22.name: Dain
wall_dain_22.text: But if I let you see me hurting too, then I've got nothing left.

wall_dain_22_b.name: {name}
wall_dain_22_b.text: *I sit outside the court line beside Dain. The volleyball on the floor rolls once between us and stops.*

wall_dain_choice.name: Dain
wall_dain_choice.text: *The rubber ball caves in against her chest. Her shoulders jerk in short motions.*
choices: I won't say anything. I'll just stay here.
You can cry. You don't have to pretend to be cheerful. Not with me.
Let's put the balls away first. And book a hospital visit tomorrow.

wall_dain_newdream_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_1.text: *The rubber sole of her sneaker briefly scrapes the floor. Dain's toe moves side to side along the court line.*

wall_dain_newdream_2_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_2_b.text: *Her sneaker stops, and Dain looks to the side.*

wall_dain_newdream_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_4.text: I'm waiting for when you want to talk.

wall_dain_newdream_5.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_5.text: *She uncurls the fingers resting on her knee one by one.*

wall_dain_newdream_6.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_6.text: Volleyball's been my whole life since I was five. Maybe it's okay to start looking for something else now.

wall_dain_newdream_7.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_7.text: While I'm figuring it out, will you sit beside me like this sometimes?

wall_dain_newdream_8.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_8.text: *Dain turns on her phone and searches for rehabilitation clinics. The ball stays beyond the line.*

wall_dain_cry_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_1.text: *She collapsed onto the court. She started crying, hugging the volleyball.*

wall_dain_cry_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_2.text: *She folds herself over the volleyball. One drop, then another, falls onto its rubber surface, and her sob echoes briefly from the empty gym walls.*

wall_dain_cry_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_3.text: I bandaged my knee alone every morning.

wall_dain_cry_4.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_4.text: I even put it in my phone alarm: “Smile today.”

wall_dain_cry_5.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_5.text: I looked at it and raised the corners of my mouth in the mirror. Every day.

wall_dain_cry_6.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_6.text: *She deletes the alarm title, 'Smile today too.' In the blank, she writes, 'Tell Mom about my knee,' and saves it.*

wall_dain_lastspike_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_1.text: *I take the ball from Dain's arms. She stays seated while {name} walks alone toward the ball rack.*

wall_dain_lastspike_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_2.text: *Dain looks up from the ball rack.* Wait. Why are you deciding everything?

wall_dain_lastspike_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_3.text: I'll stop. Tell me what you need right now.

wall_dain_lastspike_3_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_3_b.text: *She loosens her knee brace, then refastens it without putting pressure on the joint.* I should go back to the hospital, shouldn't I?

wall_dain_lastspike_3_c.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_3_c.text: Yeah. And this time, stay for the full results.

wall_dain_lastspike_4.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_4.text: I still don't know about going pro. But I'm done hiding it and playing through the pain.

wall_dain_lastspike_4_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_4_b.text: *She opens the orthopedic appointment page on her phone. The earliest date is Monday.*

wall_dain_lastspike_5.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_5.text: I'll tell Mom and Coach tomorrow too.

wall_dain_lastspike_6.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_6.text: Will you come with me when I go to the hospital?

wall_dain_farewell_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_farewell_1.text: *While {name} puts the balls in the rack, she braces herself on the bench and slowly stands.*

wall_dain_farewell_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_farewell_2.text: *I leave the gym with Dain. We pass by the back gate of the school.*

wall_dain_mention_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_mention_1.text: You know what Seoyeon said to me? Nothing. She just looked at me.

wall_dain_mention_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_mention_2.text: If she'd said something, I could've fought back. When someone says nothing, it makes YOU feel like the bad guy.

wall_dain_mention_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_mention_3.text: *One step breaks short. When she starts walking again, she shortens her stride to match {name} beside her.*

wall_dain_skin70_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_skin70_1.text: *Dain opens her arms and waits for {name}'s answer.*

wall_dain_skin70_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_skin70_2.text: Just stay like this for a minute.

wall_dain_skin70_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_skin70_3.text: *After making sure she has permission, Dain steps closer. Tears spread across my shirt, and the arms around my back don't loosen for a long time.*

wall_dain_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_skin60_1.text: *We sit side by side on a bench by the school's back gate. Dain looks pointedly at the empty space on my lap.*

wall_dain_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_1.text: *After parting from Dain, I notice a single light still burning in the library annex.*

wall_dain_glimpse_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_2.text: *Yuna sits before an open book, staring through the window. Not a single page turns.*

wall_dain_glimpse_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_4.text: *Yuna steps right up to {name} and braces one hand against the shelf. She lets her blazer slip below one shoulder and uses the other hand to tug down the neckline of her dark top. Between her bare shoulder and tattoo, her red eyes stay level with {name}. Dain's 'I'm home!' stays at the top of the screen.*

wall_dain_glimpse_4_b.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_4_b.text: *10 PM. A message from Yuna appears just above Dain's 'Made it home!' notification.*

wall_dain_glimpse_4_c.name: Yuna
wall_dain_glimpse_4_c.text: Someone who once noticed me disappeared without a word. If I'm alone again tonight, I think I'll go back to that day. I don't care that you were with Dain. I need you to come now.
choices: Reply to Dain and keep my promise
Go back to the school gate and stay with Yuna

wall_dain_seo_tempt_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_seo_tempt_1.text: *After parting from Dain, I head for the main gate and find Seoyeon waiting by the rooftop stairs. She is smiling as usual, but her fingers crumple the edge of her sleeve.*

wall_dain_seo_tempt_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_dain_seo_tempt_2.text: When I go home tonight, I'll have to put my smile back on first. Just for tonight, let me be Seoyeon instead of the student council president. Come upstairs, and I won't let go of your hand.
choices: Reply to Dain and keep my promise
Follow Seoyeon to the roof and take her hand

wall_dain_seo_tempt_accept.name: {name}
wall_dain_seo_tempt_accept.text: *The rooftop door closes. Without a word, Seoyeon undoes her blouse and catches {name}'s wrist, drawing the hand toward her. The palm meets the bare skin of her chest through the open blouse, and Seoyeon's hand settles over it. Dain's 'You get home okay?' lights the screen.*

wall_yuna_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_1.text: *10 PM. A message from Yuna. 'School back gate. Come now.'*

wall_yuna_pre_high_2.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_pre_high_2.text: *She opens one empty hand. There is no note or bookmark.*

wall_yuna_pre_low_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_pre_low_2.text: *No words come out. Yuna doesn't ask again, either.*

wall_yuna_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_2.text: *The back gate light flickers. Yuna is standing beneath it. The book is open, but not a single page has been turned.*

wall_yuna_3.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_3.text: Follow me to the school back gate.

wall_yuna_4.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_4.text: *We pass her secret reading space in the library annex and head deeper into the basement archives. Between dusty shelves, she takes out an old envelope.*

wall_yuna_6.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_6.text: This. I got it a year ago.

wall_yuna_7.name: {name}
wall_yuna_7.text: *Letter in an envelope. — 'To Yuna. Sorry. Something came up that I couldn't talk about. — Junho Lee'*

wall_yuna_9.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_9.text: A senior who used to come here with me. — The only person I was ever close to.

wall_yuna_10.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_10.text: In middle school, I was invisible. Nobody in class talked to me.

wall_yuna_11.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_11.text: He was the first. 'I liked your writing.' — Hearing that one thing made me feel like I existed in class that day.

wall_yuna_12.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_12.text: *She says all of that without stopping once.*

wall_yuna_13.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_13.text: One day he transferred. No contact. Just this letter.

wall_yuna_14.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14.text: The person who saw that I was there disappeared. I thought nobody would notice me again.

wall_yuna_14_b.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_b.text: For a year I came here alone. Hoping he'd left something behind.

wall_yuna_14_e.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_e.text: When you first came to the library.

wall_yuna_14_f.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_f.text: You felt too much like him. That's why I was scared.

wall_yuna_14_g.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_g.text: If I got close again, you might disappear too.

wall_yuna_14_h.name: {name}
wall_yuna_14_h.text: *Dust falls along the envelope's fold. Yuna doesn't press me for an answer.*

wall_yuna_15.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_15.text: *Her eyes stay fixed on the date of the letter.* That's why I acted cold on purpose. I thought it would hurt less if I pushed people away first.

wall_yuna_16.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_16.text: But you came every day. Quietly.

wall_yuna_16_b.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_16_b.text: *The fluorescent light trembles once. Yuna bites the inside of her lip, then releases it.*

wall_yuna_choice.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_choice.text: *She tightens her grip on the book. While she waits for an answer, the corner of the letter creases a little.*
choices: I can't replace him. But I'm here now.
I'm listening to you right now.
Is that why you approached me? As a substitute for him?

wall_yuna_moved_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_1.text: At first, maybe you caught my eye because you were like him.

wall_yuna_moved_3.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_3.text: *She raises her head and looks at {name}.*

wall_yuna_moved_5.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_5.text: *She puts the letter back in its envelope and smooths the folded corner with her thumb.*

wall_yuna_moved_5_b.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_5_b.text: *Her hand releases her sleeve. She closes the one step between {name} and the shelves.*

wall_yuna_skin70_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_skin70_1.text: Can I come closer and hold your hand?

wall_yuna_skin70_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin70_2.text: *After hearing my answer, Yuna leans against my shoulder and clasps my hand.*

wall_yuna_skin70_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin70_3.text: *Yuna's hand is warmer than I expected. — That's all.*

wall_yuna_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin60_1.text: *Between the shelves of the basement archive, Yuna stands one step behind me.*

wall_yuna_skin60_2.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_skin60_2.text: Can I rest my forehead against your back? Just for a minute.

wall_yuna_sub_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_sub_1.text: Right. I shouldn't confuse the two of you.

wall_yuna_sub_2.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_sub_2.text: *Only one corner of her mouth rises. The letter goes back into the envelope.*

wall_yuna_reject_3.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_reject_3.text: *She turns away. She's walking fast. A bookmark slips from her pocket, but she doesn't pick it up.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_1.text: *After parting from Yuna, I follow the wall toward the main gate. Seoyeon is standing alone beneath the streetlight.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_2.text: *Seoyeon keeps putting her phone away and taking it out again. When she sees me, she smiles, but her fingertips crumple her sleeve.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_b.text: When I go home tonight, I'll have to put my smile back on first. Just for tonight, let me be Seoyeon instead of the student council president. Come upstairs, and I won't let go of your hand.
choices: Reply to Yuna and keep my promise
Follow Seoyeon to the roof and take her hand

wall_yuna_glimpse_4.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_4.text: *The rooftop door closes. Without a word, Seoyeon undoes her blouse and catches {name}'s wrist, drawing the hand toward her. The palm meets the bare skin of her chest through the open blouse, and Seoyeon's hand settles over it. Yuna's message buzzes once in the pocket, then a second time.*

wall_yuna_dain_tempt_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_dain_tempt_1.text: *On the way back after parting from Yuna, I find Dain by the dark gym's emergency door, picking at the tape around her knee.*

wall_yuna_dain_tempt_2.name: Dain
wall_yuna_dain_tempt_2.text: Just return ten. When we're done... hug me, okay? I can't keep pretending I'm fine by myself tonight.
choices: Reply to Yuna and keep my promise
Enter the gym and stay with Dain

wall_yuna_dain_tempt_accept.name: {name}
wall_yuna_dain_tempt_accept.text: *The last ball rolls across the floor. Dain catches her breath, grips the front hem of her jersey, and pulls it taut. She bends low until her breath, still hot from training, is only inches from {name}. Yuna's name keeps appearing on the phone screen.*

day4_night_regret.name: {name}
day4_night_regret.text: *Even after I return home, a half-written sentence remains in the chat box. The cursor blinks at the end.*

day4_night_regret_msg_seo.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_regret_msg_seo.text: The wind was nice today. I waited for a while.

day4_night_regret_msg_dain.name: Dain
day4_night_regret_msg_dain.text: Hey, today was fun. I wasn't the only one excited, right?

day4_night_regret_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_night_regret_msg_yuna.text: Today, I was looking forward to it too. Even if I talked less.

day4_night_regret_msg.name: {name}
day4_night_regret_msg.text: *The phone screen lights up. There's one line of text. The read receipt appears slowly.*

day4_night_regret_reply.name: {name}
day4_night_regret_reply.text: *I type a reply and delete it. A single consonant lingers in the text box, then disappears.*

day4_night_reflect.name: {name}
day4_night_reflect.text: *I scroll back through today's messages in chronological order. Tomorrow is the Sunday school event.*

night_homeroom_msg_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_homeroom_msg_1.text: *School learning portal notice* I've uploaded the manuscript for the literature club critique. Anyone who wants to read it can pick up a printed copy from the staff room tomorrow.

night_homeroom_msg_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_homeroom_msg_2.text: *School learning portal notice* If you'd like to leave feedback, come during literature club. You don't need to reply privately.

night_homeroom_msg_3.name: {name}
night_homeroom_msg_3.text: *Nine at night. Confirmation comments from literature club members appear one by one beneath the class notice. I add 'critique' to tomorrow's schedule.*

night_nurse_msg_1.name: School Nurse
night_nurse_msg_1.text: *School health app notification* Please check in on your condition after today's counseling session.

night_nurse_msg_2.name: {name}
night_nurse_msg_2.text: *Two buttons appear beneath the automated notice: 'Stable' and 'Need further counseling.'*

night_nurse_msg_3.name: School Nurse
night_nurse_msg_3.text: *Nurse's office notice* If you need further counseling, book a time before tomorrow's event begins. You may also choose your homeroom teacher or the counseling center.

wall_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_freetalk.text: *She wipes her damp eyes with the back of her hand and looks at {name}.* Don't go yet. Let's talk a little longer.
wall_seo_freetalk.context: It is the night of Day 4, immediately after Seoyeon opened up about family conflict and the pressure to be perfect. Whether the protagonist accepted or postponed her confession, and the comfort just shared, are established facts; follow the saved flags. Do not declare her pain cured by one conversation or reassess the relationship.
wall_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is composed and responsible, but she has lowered her guard for now. She speaks honestly without making the other person responsible for fixing her, continuing with her familiar directness and newly cautious tenderness.

wall_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
wall_dain_freetalk.text: *She exhales slowly and matches {name}'s pace.* Tonight, let's just walk together. We can talk too.
wall_dain_freetalk.context: It is the night of Day 4, after Dain revealed the truth about her knee injury and the dream that stalled with it. Whether the protagonist accepted or postponed her confession, and the comfort just shared, are fixed facts. Do not suddenly heal the injury, decide her future for her, or change the current relationship status.
wall_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is candid and physical, and she is trying not to hide her feelings either. She is quieter than usual without losing her spark, acknowledging uncertainty while finding the next words together.

wall_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_freetalk.text: *She folds the letter into her book and meets the protagonist's eyes first this time.* There's still something I want to hear.
wall_yuna_freetalk.context: It is the night of Day 4, just after Yuna faced Junho's letter and her fear of being a substitute for someone else. Whether the protagonist accepted or postponed her confession, and the feelings just confirmed, are established facts. Do not rewrite the letter, erase her fear instantly, or reassess the relationship.
wall_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is quiet and reflective, but she no longer avoids the questions that matter. Instead of hiding behind metaphor, she speaks directly when needed and listens without twisting the answer to fit her fears.

night_nurse_msg_4.name: School Nurse
night_nurse_msg_4.text: *Nurse's office notice* You don't have to reply late at night. If it's urgent, tell a parent, guardian, or another trusted adult first.

day4_night_sleep.name: {name}
day4_night_sleep.text: *I set the alarm for Sunday morning and turn off the light. One unsent sentence remains in the text box.*

day4_final.name: {name}
day4_final.text: *The clock in my room passes toward midnight. The phone screen also goes dark, leaving only one alarm.*
